ayahOccurrences.text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَدَمْدَمَ is in the derivative form: دَمْدَمَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/م/د/م   d–m–d–m anger, to shake up violently; to inflict great punishment; to bury; to smother. Of this root, دَمْدَمَ damdama occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
دَمْدَمَ damdama [quadriliteral v., intrans. with prep. عَلَى] to crush, to destroy, to visit with great punishment

(91:14) فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا but they called him a liar and hamstrung her, so their Lord crushed them for their sin and flattened it [their town].
